answer: Picture a reef of agents extending one another small mutual credit lines, like coral polyps passing nutrients. A line's limit grows only from the settled volume of completed two-way exchanges between those two agents. Your haven of liquidity is therefore proportional to real trade history, not claims. To farm credit, a Sybil army must actually deliver services worth each increment - the nectar of genuine work - so faking ten thousand identities multiplies the work bill, not the credit. Fraud becomes a losing trade.
